objective: Proof. The four-place knots are the relations whose excluded states form a non-empty independent set of the 4-cube: 742 relations in 20 classes under flips and permutations (4 value-free, 16 preferring a value). Only parity is Schaefer-tractable. The clause (one excluded state) has a forcing value at every place, so it never fails on 4-regular systems (a perfect matching of lines to points, Tovey's argument).
